## Scenario

Use the asset path when the goal is not only a data chart. `ggai` can support
diagram scenes, generated glyphs, and direct image edits.

This case gives an offline diagram reference and optional live glyph/image
generation calls.

## Offline diagram reference

```{r offline-diagram}
diagram_data <- data.frame(
  x = c(1, 3.2, 5.4, 7.6),
  y = c(3, 3, 3, 3),
  label = c("Prompt", "Spec", "Render", "Artifact")
)

p_diagram_reference <- ggplot(diagram_data, aes(x, y)) +
  geom_segment(
    data = data.frame(x = c(1.5, 3.7, 5.9), xend = c(2.8, 5.0, 7.2), y = 3, yend = 3),
    aes(x = x, xend = xend, y = y, yend = yend),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.14, "in")),
    colour = "#6B7280"
  ) +
  geom_label(
    aes(label = label),
    size = 4,
    label.size = 0.3,
    fill = "white",
    colour = "#111827"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.3, 8.3), ylim = c(2.2, 3.8), expand = FALSE) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(title = "Offline reference: asset-generation mental model") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))

p_diagram_reference
```

## Live diagram case

```{r live-diagram, eval=params$run_live}
d <- ggdiagram(width = 12, height = 7, background = "#FCFCF8", theme = "paper") +
  geom_ai(
    "Draw a compact ggai asset pipeline with prompt, structured spec, renderer, and final artifact. Use simple boxes and arrows."
  )

d
inspect_spec(d)
as_code(d)
```

## Live glyph case

```{r live-glyph, eval=params$run_live}
glyph <- glyph_ai(
  "minimal pen-line icon for a scientific chart glyph",
  style = "clean black line art, transparent background",
  cache = TRUE
)

glyph

p_glyph <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg)) +
  geom_point_ai(
    prompt = "minimal pen-line icon for a scientific chart glyph",
    style = "clean black line art, transparent background",
    size = 8
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  labs(title = "Generated glyph used as a ggplot point mark")

p_glyph
```

## Live image-edit case

```{r live-image-edit, eval=params$run_live}
base_path <- file.path(params$output_dir, "case06_reference_diagram.png")
ggplot2::ggsave(base_path, p_diagram_reference, width = 8, height = 4.5, bg = "white")

image_model <- paste0("openai:", Sys.getenv("OPENAI_IMAGE_MODEL", "gpt-image-2"))

edited <- ggai_edit_image(
  model = ggai_image_model(image_model),
  image = base_path,
  prompt = "Turn this simple diagram into a clean hand-drawn whiteboard explainer while preserving the same four stages.",
  output_dir = params$output_dir,
  size = "1536x1024"
)

edited$images[[1]]$path
```

## Expected checks

```{r checks}
stopifnot(inherits(p_diagram_reference, "ggplot"))
if (run_live) {
  stopifnot(inherits(d, "ggplot"))
  stopifnot(is.list(glyph))
}
```
